using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
using JSON3
using Random
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

function cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_1!(b1, h1, n_h, w1, x)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s1 = w1[i_j] * x[1] + b1[i_j]
    h1[i_j] = tanh(s1)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_2!(b2, h1, h2, n_h, w2)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s2 = b2[i_j2]
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        s2 = s2 + w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] * h1[i_k]
    end
    h2[i_j2] = tanh(s2)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_3!(h2, h2b, n_h, s3b, w3, w3b)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - n_h, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_k2 = n_h + (__tid - 1) * -1
    w3b[i_k2] = w3b[i_k2] + h2[i_k2] * s3b
    h2b[i_k2] = h2b[i_k2] + w3[i_k2] * s3b
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_4!(b2, b2b, h1, h1b, h2b, n_h, w2, w2b)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s2b = 0.0
    s2 = b2[i_j2]
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        s2 = s2 + w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] * h1[i_k]
    end
    __oldb_0 = h2b[i_j2]
    h2b[i_j2] = 0.0
    s2b = s2b + (1.0 - tanh(s2) ^ 2) * __oldb_0
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        __cse_2 = w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k]
        __cse_3 = h1[i_k]
        s2 = s2 + __cse_2 * __cse_3
        w2b[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] = w2b[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] + __cse_3 * s2b
        CUDA.@atomic h1b[i_k] += __cse_2 * s2b
    end
    __oldb_0 = s2b
    s2b = 0.0
    b2b[i_j2] = b2b[i_j2] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_5!(b1, b1b, h1b, n_h, w1, w1b, x, xb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s1b = 0.0
    __cse_4 = w1[i_j]
    __cse_5 = x[1]
    s1 = __cse_4 * __cse_5 + b1[i_j]
    __oldb_0 = h1b[i_j]
    h1b[i_j] = 0.0
    s1b = s1b + (1.0 - tanh(s1) ^ 2) * __oldb_0
    __oldb_0 = s1b
    s1b = 0.0
    w1b[i_j] = w1b[i_j] + __cse_5 * __oldb_0
    CUDA.@atomic xb[1] += __cse_4 * __oldb_0
    b1b[i_j] = b1b[i_j] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function mlp1d_b_v3(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, w1, w1b, b1, b1b, w2, w2b, b2, b2b, w3, w3b, b3, b3b, h1, h1b, h2, h2b, o, ob, n_h)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s1 = 0.0
    s2 = 0.0
    s3 = 0.0
    s1b = 0.0
    s2b = 0.0
    s3b = 0.0
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_1!(b1, h1, n_h, w1, x)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_2!(b2, h1, h2, n_h, w2)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            s3 = b3[1]
        end
    for i_k2 = 1:n_h
        CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                s3 = s3 + w3[i_k2] * h2[i_k2]
            end
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            o[1] = s3
            __cse_0 = o[1] - y[1]
            loss[1] = loss[1] + __cse_0 ^ 2
            __cse_1 = (2__cse_0) * lossb[1]
            ob[1] = ob[1] + __cse_1
            yb[1] = yb[1] + -__cse_1
            __oldb_0 = ob[1]
            ob[1] = 0.0
            s3b = s3b + __oldb_0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - n_h, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_3!(h2, h2b, n_h, s3b, w3, w3b)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            __oldb_0 = s3b
            s3b = 0.0
            b3b[1] = b3b[1] + __oldb_0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_4!(b2, b2b, h1, h1b, h2b, n_h, w2, w2b)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v3_mlp1d_b_5!(b1, b1b, h1b, n_h, w1, w1b, x, xb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_1!(b1, h1, n_h, w1, x)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s1 = w1[i_j] * x[1] + b1[i_j]
    h1[i_j] = tanh(s1)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_2!(b2, h1, h2, n_h, w2)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s2 = b2[i_j2]
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        s2 = s2 + w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] * h1[i_k]
    end
    h2[i_j2] = tanh(s2)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_3!(h2, h2b, n_h, s3b, w3, w3b)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - n_h, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_k2 = n_h + (__tid - 1) * -1
    w3b[i_k2] = w3b[i_k2] + h2[i_k2] * s3b
    h2b[i_k2] = h2b[i_k2] + w3[i_k2] * s3b
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_4!(b2, b2b, h1, h1b, h2b, n_h, w2, w2b)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j2 = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s2b = 0.0
    s2 = b2[i_j2]
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        s2 = s2 + w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] * h1[i_k]
    end
    __oldb_0 = h2b[i_j2]
    h2b[i_j2] = 0.0
    s2b = s2b + (1.0 - tanh(s2) ^ 2) * __oldb_0
    for i_k = 1:n_h
        __cse_2 = w2[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k]
        __cse_3 = h1[i_k]
        s2 = s2 + __cse_2 * __cse_3
        w2b[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] = w2b[(i_j2 - 1) * n_h + i_k] + __cse_3 * s2b
        CUDA.@atomic h1b[i_k] += __cse_2 * s2b
    end
    __oldb_0 = s2b
    s2b = 0.0
    b2b[i_j2] = b2b[i_j2] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_5!(b1, b1b, h1b, n_h, w1, w1b, x, xb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_j = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    s1b = 0.0
    __cse_4 = w1[i_j]
    __cse_5 = x[1]
    s1 = __cse_4 * __cse_5 + b1[i_j]
    __oldb_0 = h1b[i_j]
    h1b[i_j] = 0.0
    s1b = s1b + (1.0 - tanh(s1) ^ 2) * __oldb_0
    __oldb_0 = s1b
    s1b = 0.0
    w1b[i_j] = w1b[i_j] + __cse_5 * __oldb_0
    CUDA.@atomic xb[1] += __cse_4 * __oldb_0
    b1b[i_j] = b1b[i_j] + __oldb_0
    return nothing
end

function mlp1d_b_v7(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, w1, w1b, b1, b1b, w2, w2b, b2, b2b, w3, w3b, b3, b3b, h1, h1b, h2, h2b, o, ob, n_h)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    s1 = 0.0
    s2 = 0.0
    s3 = 0.0
    s1b = 0.0
    s2b = 0.0
    s3b = 0.0
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_1!(b1, h1, n_h, w1, x)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_2!(b2, h1, h2, n_h, w2)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            s3 = b3[1]
        end
    if div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1 < 32768
        for i_k2 = 1:n_h
            CUDA.@allowscalar begin
                    s3 = s3 + w3[i_k2] * h2[i_k2]
                end
        end
    else
        s3 = s3 + mapreduce(init = zero(eltype(view(h2, 1:n_h))), ((__mr_1, __mr_2)->__mr_2 * __mr_1), +, view(h2, 1:n_h), view(w3, 1:n_h))
    end
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            o[1] = s3
            __cse_0 = o[1] - y[1]
            loss[1] = loss[1] + __cse_0 ^ 2
            __cse_1 = (2__cse_0) * lossb[1]
            ob[1] = ob[1] + __cse_1
            yb[1] = yb[1] + -__cse_1
            __oldb_0 = ob[1]
            ob[1] = 0.0
            s3b = s3b + __oldb_0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(1 - n_h, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_3!(h2, h2b, n_h, s3b, w3, w3b)
    CUDA.@allowscalar begin
            __oldb_0 = s3b
            s3b = 0.0
            b3b[1] = b3b[1] + __oldb_0
        end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_4!(b2, b2b, h1, h1b, h2b, n_h, w2, w2b)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = max(1, Base.cld(div(n_h - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block)) cuda_kernel_v7_mlp1d_b_5!(b1, b1b, h1b, n_h, w1, w1b, x, xb)
    return nothing
end

function mlp1d_b_reset_accum!(w1b, b1b, w2b, b2b, w3b, b3b)
    fill!(w1b, 0.0)
    fill!(b1b, 0.0)
    fill!(w2b, 0.0)
    fill!(b2b, 0.0)
    fill!(w3b, 0.0)
    fill!(b3b, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function mlp1d_b_reset_reduced!(loss)
    fill!(loss, 0.0)
    return nothing
end

function mlp1d_b_reset_local!(xb, yb, h1b, h2b, ob)
    fill!(xb, 0.0)
    fill!(yb, 0.0)
    fill!(h1b, 0.0)
    fill!(h2b, 0.0)
    fill!(ob, 0.0)
    return nothing
end



const NH = 16
const BATCH = 32
const STEPS = 1000
const LR = 0.01
f_target(x) = 2.0 * x - x^3

function adam_step!(p, g, m, v, t, lr, b1, b2, eps)
    @. m = b1 * m + (1 - b1) * g
    @. v = b2 * v + (1 - b2) * g * g
    mh = 1 - b1^t; vh = 1 - b2^t
    @. p -= lr * (m / mh) / (sqrt(v / vh) + eps)
    return nothing
end

function train(adjoint_fn)
    Random.seed!(20260905)
    z(n) = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    ps = (w1 = CUDA.CuArray(randn(NH)), b1 = z(NH),
          w2 = CUDA.CuArray(randn(NH*NH) ./ sqrt(NH)), b2 = z(NH),
          w3 = CUDA.CuArray(randn(NH) ./ sqrt(NH)), b3 = z(1))
    gs = map(a -> z(length(a)), ps); ms = map(a -> z(length(a)), ps); vs = map(a -> z(length(a)), ps)
    loss = z(1); lossb = CUDA.ones(Float64,1)
    x = z(1); xb = z(1); y = z(1); yb = z(1)
    h1 = z(NH); h1b = z(NH); h2 = z(NH); h2b = z(NH); o = z(1); ob = z(1)
    xbuf = zeros(1); ybuf = zeros(1)
    CUDA.synchronize(); t0 = time()
    for step in 1:STEPS
        mlp1d_b_reset_accum!(gs.w1, gs.b1, gs.w2, gs.b2, gs.w3, gs.b3)
        mlp1d_b_reset_reduced!(loss)
        for _ in 1:BATCH
            mlp1d_b_reset_local!(xb, yb, h1b, h2b, ob)
            xbuf[1] = 2.0 * rand() - 1.0; ybuf[1] = f_target(xbuf[1])
            copyto!(x, xbuf); copyto!(y, ybuf); fill!(lossb, 1.0)
            adjoint_fn(loss, lossb, x, xb, y, yb, ps.w1, gs.w1, ps.b1, gs.b1,
                       ps.w2, gs.w2, ps.b2, gs.b2, ps.w3, gs.w3, ps.b3, gs.b3,
                       h1, h1b, h2, h2b, o, ob, NH)
        end
        for a in gs; @. a /= BATCH; end
        for (q, g, m, v) in zip(values(ps), values(gs), values(ms), values(vs))
            adam_step!(q, g, m, v, step, LR, 0.9, 0.999, 1e-8)
        end
    end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    return (time() - t0, Array(loss)[1] / BATCH, Array(ps.w3))
end

function main()
    r = Dict{String,Any}("device" => CUDA.name(CUDA.device()), "steps" => STEPS)
    train(mlp1d_b_v3)   # warm both paths before timing either
    train(mlp1d_b_v7)
    for rep in 1:2
        t3, l3, w3a = train(mlp1d_b_v3)
        t7, l7, w7a = train(mlp1d_b_v7)
        r["v3_seconds_r$(rep)"] = round(t3, digits = 2)
        r["v7_seconds_r$(rep)"] = round(t7, digits = 2)
        r["loss_match_r$(rep)"] = l3 == l7
        r["w3_max_diff_r$(rep)"] = maximum(abs.(w3a .- w7a))
    end
    println(JSON3.write(r))
end
main()
